title: Iris Backwater
description: A long minor-key ballad moves in phrases of three, five and six bars. The melody stretches across an unhurried bass, then falls silent for an ascending left-hand soliloquy. Its return has lighter harmony and ends on the sixth, leaving a little daylight in the water.
technical_note: Shape the long melody independently of each bass arrival. The left-hand treble solo should sing without added pedal haze. Preserve the rests at the phrase ends and the clear top notes of the returning chord pairs.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
